name: Adaptive Sampling (Sparse Grid)
definition: An optimization taking advantage of coherence in projections (often from sensing device blurring) by casting a sparse grid of rays (less than one per pixel) and adaptively increasing rays in high-complexity regions.
summary: Adaptive Sampling (Sparse Grid) reduces computational overhead by casting fewer than one ray per pixel and adaptively refining high-complexity regions, distinguishing itself by decoupling sampling from display resolution.
